content: Amoonenne Mo7aabe Xooneteth
Hessafe guye Mo7aabetinne Amooneti qasse isttara issife Ma7uunetappe amardayti Iyoosaafixe bolla worajjida.
Amarda asati Iyoosaafixekko yiidi, «Maxine abbafe he pinththan diza Aaraame biittafe daro olanchchati nena olanaas yiidi Haxaxoone Taamaare geetettiza En-Gaaden deettes» gida.
Histtiin Iyoosaafixey keehi yayyidi GODAA oychchanaas ba qofa qachchidi Yuhuda biittan ubbaan xooma awajjides.
Yuhuda asay ubbay GODAAPPE maado koyanaas issi bolla shiiqides; istti GODAAPPE maado koyanaas Yuhuda katamata ubbaafe yida.
Iyoosaafixey Yuhuda asaynne Yerusalaame asay shiiqida duulata giddon Xoossa keeththaa sinththan diza ooraththa zagozan eqqidi,
«Abeet GODAA nu Xoossawu! Salon de7iza Xoossay nena! Sa7an de7iza kawoteththata ubbaa haarizay nena! Wolqqaynne maatay nees diza gishshas nenara eqettanaas dandayzay deenna.
Abeet nu Xoossawu! Kase ha biittan de7izayta ne dere Isra7eele sinththafe yedeththada ne siiqiza Abrahaame zereththatas mernaas immiday nena!
Istti ha biittan de7ida; istti hayssan ne sunththas Xoossa keeth keexxidi,

‹Nu bolla pirda mashshay, woykko iita hargey, woykko koshay nu bolla gakkiko ne sunththay izan xeygettida ha Xoossa Keeththa sinththaninne ne sinththan eqqidi nu metoza gishshas neekko waassana; nekka nu waaso siyada nuna ashshana› gida.
«Isra7eele derey Gibxeppe kezida wode istti biitta worajjontta mala ne diggiin Isra7eele asay dhayssontta aggiin heen attida Amoone asay, Mo7aabe asaynne Eedoome asay nu bolla worajjida.
Nuni ooththidayssas istti nuus zaaridayssa be7a; neni nuus immida xinxxo biittaafe istti nuna yedeththanaas yida.

Abeet nu Xoossawu, neni istta bolla pirdikii? Ays giikko nuna olanaas yida ha daro olanchchatara olettanaas nuus wolqqay baawa; nuni ooththanayssaka erokko; gido attiin nu ayfeti nena xeelleettes» gides.
Yuhuda asay ubbay bantta machchetara, bantta naytara, bantta yidha naytara issi bolla GODAA sinththan eqqida.

Hessafe guye Zakaraasa naa Yahazi7eeley duulata giddon eqqi dishin GODAA Ayanay iza bolla wodhdhides; Zakaraasi Bannaya naa; Bannayay Yi7i7eele naa; Yi7i7eeley Maataaniya naa; Maataaniyay Lewe qommo Aasaafe zarkke.

GODAA Ayanay Yahazi7eele bolla wodhdhiin, «Kawo Iyoosaafixe, Yuhudaninne Yerusalaamen diza asay ubbay siyite! GODAY inttena, ‹Olaa olettanay Xoossa attiin inttena gidontta gishshas ha daro olanchchata gaason yayyoftenne dagammofte.
Wonto intte istta olanaas duge wodhdhite; isttika inttenara olettanaas Ziize pudunththaa kezana; intte istta Yiru7eele Bazzon diza zulleza wurseththan demmana.

Ha olaa olettanay inttena gidekketa; intte soho soho oykki eqqidi GODAY inttena ashshizayssa be7ite; Yuhudaninne Yerusalaamen diza asawu yayyoftenne dagammofte! Isttara olettanaas wonto kezite; GODAY inttenara gidana› gees» gides.
Iyoosaafixey gaden gufanni goynnides; Yuhuda asaynne Yerusalaame asay ubbay GODAA sinththan gufanni goynnides.
Qa7aate zarkketappenne Qoore zarkketappe amarda Leweti eqqidi bantta qaala dhoqqu histtidi GODAA Isra7eele Xoossaa galatida.

Istti maalado wonttara dendidi Tequhe bazzo baana kezida; istti oge kezida mala Iyoosaafixey dendi eqqidi, «Yuhudanne Yerusalaame asawu tani gizayssa ezgi siyite; GODAAN intte Xoossan ammanettite; intte minnana; qasse nabeta qaalan ammanettite; yo7o ubbay inttes injjetana» gides.
Iyoosaafixey asaara zorettidaappe guyen mazamure yexxizaytanne GODAA geeshshateththaa bonchchoza sabbizayti bantta seelo may7o may7idi olanchchata sinththara bishe,
Istti mazamure yeththinne saba doommida mala Yuhuda olanaas yida Amooneta bolla, Mo7aabeta bollanne Eedoometa bolla GODAY qoppontta ola denththides.
Amoonetinne Mo7aabeti Eedoometa bolla dendidi istta mulera dhayssidaappe guyen bantta giddon issoy issaa dhayssanaas dendida.
Yuhuda asay duge bazzoza qonccen bessizaso yiidi cora olanchchata be7ishin biittay gadey aha xalla gididayssa be7ida; isttafe issi asikka attibeenna.

Hessafe guye Iyoosaafixeynne iza asay di7o miish shiishshanaas biidi daro aqota, dumma ola massarata, may7otanne hara al7o miishshata demmida; istti di7oyssa ubbaa tookki efanaas dandaybeettenna; di7ettida miishshay keehippe daro gidida gishshas hessa shiishshanaas heedzdzu gallas ekkides.
Istti oydanththo gallas kase GODAA galatida zullen shiiqida; hessafe dendoyssan he sohozi galata zulle geetettides.
Hessafe guye GODAY istti ba morkketa bolla ufayettana mala ooththida gishshas Yuhuda asaynne Yerusalaame asay ubbay Iyoosaafixey kaaleththiin ufayettishe Yerusalaame simmida.
Istti Yerusalaame gakkida mala diith diixxishe, maasinqo shocishenne zaye punnishe Xoossa keeth bida.
GODAY Isra7eele morkketa olidayssa biitta bolla de7iza kawoteththati ubbay siyida wode istti Xoossas yayyida.
Xoossay Iyoosaafixes ubbaa baggara shemppo immida gishshas iza kawoteththay woppa demmides.
Iyoosaafixe Kawoteththa Wurseth
Iyoosaafixey Yuhudan kawotiza wode iza layththay 35; izi Yerusalaamen nam7u tamman ichchash layth kawotides; iza aayeya Shilihe biyo Azubbo geetettawus.
Iyoosaafixey ba aawa Aasa ogen hemettides; izi he ogeppe sher7i gibeenna; GODAA sinththan izi suure miish ooththides.
Gido attiin goynniza dhoqqasohota ubbaa dhayssibeenna; asaykka buro ba kumeththa wozinappe ba aawata Xoossaako simmibeenna.
Iyoosaafixey hanida haray koyroppe wurseth gakkanaas Isra7eele kawota Taarike Maxaafan, Hanaaniya naa Iyu Taarike maxaafan xaafetti uttides.
Issi wode Yuhuda Kawo Iyoosaafixey iita miish ooththida Isra7eele kawo Akaziyaasara issife ooththanaas caaqettides.
Histtidi Iyoosaafixey izara zal7iza gita markabeta oosisanaas haasayetti giigides; he markabeta Eexiyoon-Gaabiren oosisida.

Hessafe guye Mareeshappe yida Dodawe naa El7ezeerey, «Neni Akaziyaasara issife ooththana caaqettida gishshas GODAY ne oosoza dhayssana» giidi Iyoosaafixes tinbite yootides; markabetikka meqerettida; hessafe dendoyssan zal7es Tarseese baanaas dandaybeettenna.
